description: This file contains unit tests for the class 'ThingModified' in the 'org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.things' package. It tests immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and object creation error handling.

classes.name: ThingModifiedTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the 'ThingModified' class, focusing on immutability, equality, JSON serialization, and validation.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that instances of 'ThingModified' are immutable using MutabilityAssert and checks related to 'Thing'.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of 'hashCode' and 'equals' methods of 'ThingModified' using EqualsVerifier with prefab JSON objects for deep equality checks.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThing
methods.description: Ensures that creating a 'ThingModified' instance with a null 'Thing' throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the 'toJson' method of 'ThingModified' produces the expected JSON structure.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests deserialization of 'ThingModified' from JSON string and verifies correctness of parsed object.
